title: LEGO Harry Potter Slytherin House Banner Building Set 76410 - Hogwarts Castle Common Room Toy or Wall Display, Collectible Harry Potter Gift Idea for Boys, Girls and Kids with Draco Malfoy Minifigure
features: Collect All Hogwarts Houses - Part of a collection of 4 LEGO Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle house banners, including Gryffindor (76409) and Ravenclaw (76411).
Slytherin House Banner - LEGO Harry Potter building toy features a Slytherin House Banner that doubles as wall art or opens to reveal a common room for play inside.
Minifigures Included - Draco Malfoy, Pansy Parkinson, and Blaise Zabini LEGO Harry Potter minifigures, plus Slytherin's Locket, a snake element, and more.
Common Room Playset - Harry Potter toy Slytherin common room includes buildable sofa, table, lamps, steps, and a secret message cupboard.
Display as Wall Art - Close the banner to display the crest and use the hanger for cool Harry Potter Hogwarts House wall decoration.
Banner Measurements - The banner measures over 20 cm (8 in.) high, 13 cm (5 in.) wide and 3 cm (1 in.) deep when closed. Contains 349 pieces, perfect gift for kids.
3D Lenticular Backboard - Showcases Black Lake underwater scenes and Salazar Slytherin's serious/smiling face through the window.
